title: Captain Guegler and PFC Jones at the Huey
description: Two officers pose on a paved flight line before a UH-1 Huey while PFC Jones, in a white T-shirt, climbs in at the cargo door behind them. The officer at right, facing the camera in uniform, is the captain Larry has long remembered as "Guegler" — here he offered Gutler and Getler as other spellings — a man in his late fifties who had been in the military a long time and was always said to be a great pilot. The officer at left Larry can't name.
larrysRecollection:
Left: don’t remember name

Right, white t-shirt is PFC Jones

Right facing camera in uniform, looking at camera is Captain Gutler / Getler / Guegler
He was in his late 50s and was in the military a long time

My father always heard that the captain was a great pilot
researchNotes: Relayed by Larry's son from Larry's dictation (2026-08-15 session; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0020-c18035376.json and -c18035378.json). First photograph of Captain Guegler — previously only a remembered name (unresolved question #5). The 'great pilot' reputation and this flight-line setting fit the aviator-badged right officer the survey described. Magnification pass 2026-08-15 (research/magnification/): the tape the survey read as possibly beginning 'J' is actually the gold U.S. ARMY tape below clear aviator wings — no conflict with the Guegler identification; his own name tape is hidden behind the jacket panel. The left officer, the round orange-gold shoulder patch, and further identity notes remain open (research/people/captain-guegler.md).
